algorithm_semantics.fidelity_api: eval_objectives is a list of scalar objective callables ordered by fidelity level

comparison_requirements: Use a preregistered scalarization of the casting objective vector for direct MF-SCBO comparison; do not call its fidelity list a multi-objective interface.
Convert the casting feasible margin m(x) >= 0 into constraint c(x) = -m(x) <= 0.
Freeze objective normalization and scalarization weights before held-out task outcomes are unsealed.
Record both total evaluation cost and high-fidelity evaluation count; include initialization cost and full environment/source digests.
Preserve separate evaluated-center and predicted-center variants and use the same target task, seed, initialization-cost, and stop-budget protocol.
Audit final candidate truth after optimization; never use the audit truth inside the optimizer's search loop.
Keep the Python/PyTorch/BoTorch experiment isolated from production Rust code.
claim_ceiling: Source and semantics are pinned from repository artifacts. This lock does not mean MF-SCBO has been installed, executed, reproduced, or compared against Symthaea.
